name: Smart Sense – Revolutionizing Your Knowledge Base with AI-Powered RAG for Posts, Pages, Docs, and Custom Post Types of your choice
author: Shazahanul Islam Shohag

sections.description:
In today’s digital landscape, providing instant, accurate information to your website visitors is paramount. Whether you’re running a bustling e-commerce store, a comprehensive support portal, or an educational platform, the ability to quickly answer user queries directly impacts user satisfaction and engagement. Smart Sense is a groundbreaking WordPress plugin designed to transform your website’s existing posts and pages into a dynamic, AI-powered knowledge base.

Leveraging the power of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Smart Sense intelligently processes your content, allowing your users to ask natural language questions and receive precise, contextually relevant answers directly from your website’s information. Say goodbye to endless scrolling and frustrating searches; with Smart Sense, your content works harder, delivering immediate value to your audience.

Smart Sense changes the way search works on your site. Instead of only listing posts, it creates an AI-powered search summary at the top of the results page. The summary gives a combined answer to the visitor’s query. Below the summary, the plugin shows links to the original posts and pages where the answer comes from. Visitors get the key information right away and can click through to read more if they want the full details.

The plugin works with OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude. You can pick the provider you prefer and add your API key in the settings. If you want even more accurate results, you can enable embeddings. That helps the AI understand context better and generate smarter summaries.

Smart Sense is designed to be lightweight. It won’t bloat your site or slow down your search. You don’t need coding knowledge to get started. Install it, add your API key, and you’re ready to go.

The plugin works for posts, pages, and even custom post types. That makes it useful for blogs, business sites, or larger directories. No matter what type of content you publish, your visitors will see clear summaries right on the search page.

Smart Sense is the perfect AI search plugin for WordPress. It helps visitors find answers faster, improves user experience, and guides them to the right content efficiently.

Who Can Benefit from Smart Sense?

Smart Sense is not just another plugin; it’s a versatile tool designed to empower a wide array of WordPress website administrators. Regardless of your website’s primary function, if you have valuable content stored in posts and pages, Smart Sense can unlock its full potential.

For E-commerce Store Owners

Are your customers constantly asking about product specifications, shipping policies, or return procedures? Instead of directing them to static FAQ pages or overwhelming product descriptions, imagine a system where they can simply ask, “What’s the warranty on this laptop?” or “How long does shipping to California take?” Smart Sense can instantly pull the relevant information from your product pages and policy documents, providing immediate answers and reducing the burden on your customer support team. This leads to higher customer satisfaction, fewer abandoned carts, and ultimately, increased sales.

For Support Portal Managers

If your website serves as a hub for customer support, Smart Sense is a game-changer. Transform your extensive knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and how-to tutorials into an interactive Q&A system. Users can articulate their problems in their own words, and Smart Sense will retrieve the most accurate solutions from your existing content. This significantly improves self-service options, reduces support ticket volume, and allows your support agents to focus on more complex issues. It’s like having an intelligent virtual assistant available 24/7.

For Educational and Informational Websites

Whether you’re a blogger, an online course provider, or a non-profit organization disseminating information, your content is your asset. Smart Sense enables your audience to delve deeper into your topics by asking specific questions. Students can get instant clarifications on course material, readers can explore nuances of an article, and visitors can quickly find answers to their queries about your organization’s mission or services. This fosters a more engaging and interactive learning or informational experience, making your content more accessible and valuable.

For Community Forum Administrators

For websites with active community forums, Smart Sense can act as a powerful first line of defense for common questions. Before users post a new query, they can leverage Smart Sense to see if the answer already exists within your forum’s historical discussions or related knowledge base articles. This helps in reducing redundant posts, guiding users to existing solutions, and improving the overall efficiency and knowledge sharing within your community.

For Corporate and Internal Knowledge Base Managers

Beyond public-facing websites, many organizations use WordPress for internal knowledge bases, wikis, and documentation. Smart Sense can significantly enhance internal information retrieval, allowing employees to quickly find answers to HR policies, IT troubleshooting steps, project documentation, or company guidelines. This boosts employee productivity, reduces internal support requests, and ensures consistent access to critical information across the organization.

Key Features of Smart Sense

Smart Sense is built with user-friendliness and powerful functionality in mind, offering a suite of features that make it an indispensable tool for any WordPress site:

  • AI-Powered Search Summaries: Instead of showing only a list of results, Smart Sense creates a short AI-written summary at the top of the page. The summary gives visitors a quick answer to their search query, similar to Google’s generative search.
  • Direct Links to Original Content: Right under the summary, Smart Sense shows links to the posts or pages where the information came from. Visitors get the key points instantly but can still click through to explore the full content.
  • Works with Multiple AI Providers: You are not limited to one AI service. The plugin supports OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude. Just paste your API key in the settings, and Smart Sense starts working.
  • Optional Embeddings for Better Accuracy: You can enable embeddings if you want more accurate and context-aware summaries. This helps the AI understand your content better before writing the final summary.
  • Supports All Content Types: Smart Sense doesn’t stop at blog posts. It works with pages and custom post types, too. That makes it useful for blogs, business sites, learning platforms, or directories.
  • Simple Setup for Beginners: You don’t need coding skills. Install the plugin, add your API key, and you are ready to go. The plugin runs on its own once it’s active.
  • Lightweight and Fast: Smart Sense is built to be light. It won’t bloat your site or slow down your search page. The focus stays on speed and a smooth user experience.

How Smart Sense Works: A Glimpse Under the Hood

Smart Sense operates on the principle of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), a powerful AI paradigm that combines the strengths of information retrieval with the generative capabilities of large language models. Here’s a simplified breakdown of its process:

  1. Content Indexing: Upon activation and configuration, Smart Sense intelligently indexes your selected WordPress posts and pages. This involves breaking down your content into manageable chunks and creating a searchable representation that captures the semantic meaning of the text, not just keywords.
  2. User Query: A user submits a question in natural language through a dedicated interface on your website.
  3. Retrieval: Smart Sense’s retrieval component then searches its optimized index to find the most relevant content snippets from your WordPress site that are semantically similar to the user’s query. This is where the ‘Retrieval’ part of RAG comes in – it efficiently pulls out the most pertinent information from your vast content library.
  4. Augmentation and Generation: The retrieved content snippets are then fed into a sophisticated language model, along with the original user query. This model uses the retrieved information to ‘augment’ its understanding and then ‘generates’ a concise, accurate, and contextually relevant answer. This ensures that the response is not just a direct quote but a synthesized answer based on your authoritative content.
  5. Delivery: The generated answer is then presented to the user, often with links back to the original source content on your website for further exploration and verification.

This seamless process ensures that your users receive precise answers grounded in your own content, making your website an even more valuable resource.

Privacy

This plugin relies on third-party AI services and embedding services to generate content summaries and improve the search experience.

AI Services

When enabled, the plugin will send portions of your site content (such as post titles, excerpts, or full content) to the selected AI provider in order to generate summaries. The specific provider depends on your configuration:

  • OpenAI (ChatGPT)

    • Data sent: post/page/custom post type content (as text) for summary generation.
    • Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
    • Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use

  • Google Gemini (Google AI Studio)

    • Data sent: post/page/custom post type content (as text) for summary generation.
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
    • Terms of Service: https://ai.google.dev/terms

  • Anthropic Claude

    • Data sent: post/page/custom post type content (as text) for summary generation.
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
    • Terms of Service: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/terms

No personal user data is transmitted unless it is part of the site content itself.

Embedding Service

If embedding is enabled, the plugin may send content data to the configured embedding provider in order to create vector representations (embeddings) of your site content. This allows for improved search and relevance matching. The type of data sent is limited to text content only.

The embedding process is performed by the same provider you configure in the settings (OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Anthropic Claude), and is subject to their respective terms and policies (see links above).

Third-Party Services

This plugin uses the following third-party services:
– INSPECTOR (https://inspector.dev/) for observing and analyzing the performance of the AI services.

To use the service set putenv("INSPECTOR_INGESTION_KEY=your_key_here"); in the wp-config.php file.

General Notes

  • The plugin does not collect or store your content outside of your chosen AI provider.
  • All processing of summaries or embeddings occurs via secure API requests to the external provider you configure.
  • By using this plugin and configuring an AI service, you agree that portions of your content will be transmitted to that provider in order to enable the plugin’s functionality.

Configuration

After installation, you’ll need to:
– Obtain API keys from your chosen AI provider
– Configure the AI model settings
– Enable the smart search feature
– Test the functionality on your site’s search page
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins directory or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Smart Sense > Settings in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Configure your AI provider settings:
    • Select your preferred AI provider (OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Anthropic Claude)
    • Enter your API key for the selected provider
    • Specify the AI model you want to use
  5. Configure embedding settings if needed.
  6. Enable the services from the Services tab.
  7. Your WordPress search results will now display AI-generated summaries.
sections.faq:
What does Smart Sense do?

It adds AI-generated summaries to your WordPress search results so visitors can quickly see what your content is about.

Which AI providers are supported?

OpenAI (ChatGPT), Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude.

Does the plugin store any of my content?

No. Your content is only sent to the AI provider you choose. Nothing is stored by the plugin.

What content is sent to the AI?

Post titles, excerpts, or full content depending on your settings. Only text is sent.

Do I need coding skills to use it?

No coding is required. All settings are managed in your WordPress dashboard.

Does it work with custom post types?

Yes, it works with posts, pages, and custom post types.

Is the plugin free?

Yes. But you’ll need an API key from an AI provider. Some offer free tiers or trial credits.

What are embeddings for?

Embeddings improve context and make AI summaries more accurate and relevant.

Do I need to provide AI Api keys

Yes, you need to provide API keys for the AI services you want to use. The plugin supports OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude.
